turnaround_reason: Simply Good Foods fell from ~$27 to ~$10 as its legacy Atkins brand and the acquired OWYN line softened, dragging full-year sales guidance down 7-10%; Quest remains a growth engine and the market is pricing near-permanent decline at ~6x forward earnings.
bullish_points: Cheap on forward earnings (fwd PE ~6) for a branded, cash-generative consumer-staples business with a real growth brand in Quest
Q3 FY2026 earnings came in ahead of expectations, and Q2 non-GAAP EPS of $0.42 beat consensus by ~18% — cost/margin execution is holding up even as sales dip
Adjusted EBITDA guide of $217-225M against a ~$900M market cap implies a low EV/EBITDA for a stable-demand category
Nutritional-snacking/high-protein secular tailwind still supports Quest even as Atkins fades
bearish_points: Guidance was CUT: FY2026 net sales guided to $1.31-1.35B, down 7-10% YoY — this is a shrinking top line, not yet a confirmed turn
Atkins is in structural decline and OWYN is soft; Quest has to carry the whole portfolio to offset both
'Basing' mode — the bottom is unconfirmed and the stock sits near its 52-week low; re-breakdown risk is real
Options are thin (low OI, only 4 expiries) — spot-only name; dossier margin fields null
catalyst: Sales stabilization / return to growth as Quest scales and Atkins declines annualize; evidence the guidance cut marks the trough
catalyst_timing: Next quarterly print (FY2026 Q4 / early FY2027, roughly Oct 2026) and FY2027 initial guide
suggested_trade: Spot only, small-to-medium starter near $10 with patience; add if a print confirms sales stabilization
key_risk: Atkins/OWYN erosion outpaces Quest growth and sales keep declining, turning a 'cheap staple' into a value trap
would_skip_if: Another guidance cut or Quest growth decelerates; wait for confirmed top-line stabilization before sizing up
